contract.input: Raw named float64 feature values, before historical sample guards and median imputation. Unknown omitted/nonfinite; actual zero retained.
contract.history: Safe deduplicated prior matches; exclude target ID; prior kickoff+2h strictly earlier; team-relative scores; recent window <=10.
contract.guard: Per-feature guards applied before finite checks and frozen full-history median fill. No missing indicators.
contract.trees: numeric raw threshold x<=threshold left, otherwise right; leaf values already include learning rate .05; add in stage order to baseline then sigmoid
contract.scope: Apply observation candidate marker only to actual nonblank jingcaiId; model inputs also use other company prices and safe history.
contract.scoreMeaning: frozen model score; not a calibrated per-match probability or guaranteed 35% future precision
